objective: Finish the controlled winter system with recovered XC source and deployment ownership, preserve the model-vs-grooming and Ice safety boundaries, measure the real visitor funnel, capture existing winter search intent without thin URLs, and then freeze feature work until observed data or a defect justifies reopening it.
fatalPenalties: claiming XC source or Git-to-deployment ownership without recorded recovery and deployment evidence
losing or bypassing the controlled xcski build/deployment path
creating a new indexable winter landing URL that competes with the existing XC or Ice owners
weakening the Michigan Ice safety boundary or turning remote data into a safety rating
turning weather or modeled snow data into an unsupported grooming, opening, safety, or skiability claim
adding cookies, localStorage, fingerprinting, geolocation, or personal data to winter funnel measurement
continuing winter feature churn after the 2026-27 ownership hardening without a documented reopen trigger
reopenTriggers: in-season Search Console or first-party behavior data identifies a measured loss

outcomeMetrics.principle: The readiness score is a build gate. Real winter traffic and behavior are the market loss function.
funnel: XC live or Ice regional handoff
